title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S02 E02 — Everybody Knows Everybody
A woman in Hancock is picked up on traffic warrants, but when she is booked, a surprising charge threatens her freedom; in Virginia Beach, a man busted for being drunk in public requires medical attention.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S02 E03 — It's Not My First Rodeo
In Modesto, a woman is brought in for her 14th felony charge, while a young man is arrested after not having reflectors on his bicycle; in Virginia Beach, a man dances his way to the drunk tank and a woman gets a surprise embezzlement charge.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S02 E04 — Bonnie & Clyde
In Modesto, Calif., a fight at a marijuana dispensary ends with a stabbing; in Bay St. Louis, Miss., a 22-year-old rapper is delighted by his mugshot, but not by the possibility of spending his birthday in jail.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S02 E05 — Locked Up in Love

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S02 E06 — Public Drunk at a Bar!

title: Booked: First Day In
description:

description:
